theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_cr_nusc_flat_point_persists
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (S Dset : Set (Euclid P)) (Ss Ds : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)), 0 < β → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ Dset → ∀ᶠ k in atTop, K ⊆ Ds k) → (∀ (sub : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ → Euclid P) (x : Euclid P), StrictMono sub → (∀ k, z k ∈ Ss (sub k)) → Tendsto z atTop (𝓝 x) → x ∈ Dset → x ∈ S) → ∀ w : Euclid P, (∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ball w ρ ⊆ Dset ∧ ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n ∧ ∃ s : ℝ, s < β * ρ ∧ ∀ y ∈ S, y ∈ ball w ρ → ‖(y - w) - Q.starProjection (y - w)‖ ≤ s) → ∀ (σ : ℕ → ℕ) (v : ℕ → Euclid P), StrictMono σ → Tendsto v atTop (𝓝 w) → ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ball (v i) ρ ⊆ Ds (σ i) ∧ ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n ∧ ∃ s : ℝ, s < β * ρ ∧ ∀ y ∈ Ss (σ i), y ∈ ball (v i) ρ → ‖(y - v i) - Q.starProjection (y - v i)‖ ≤ s
